text:
support-alex: FYI customer (acct: AcmeMedia) opening a high-priority escalation — production errors started ~09:03 UTC after the v7 rollout. 400s from our exec API and 401s from the company-kb tool.
support-alex: Customer impact: chat endpoints returning tool-call failures that previously worked, some responses missing tool output entirely. Billing spike noticed (token usage + external tool calls). :rotating_light:
cust-rep-ek: They pasted a failing sample request: 
```
POST /v1/chat
{
  "model": "redwood-v7",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"find policy doc for refund"}],
  "tools": ["company-kb","web_search"]
}
```
Response: 200 OK (chat) but assistant returned error block: `ToolInvocationError: company-kb -> schema mismatch: missing field 'doc_id'` then followup 401 when resolver proxies to legacy-kb.
eng-runtime-lee: looking at logs now, will paste snippets.
eng-runtime-lee: log tail: `2026-02-11T09:02:13Z INFO resolver: selected tool web_search (score=0.52) over company-kb (score=0.48) for redwood-v7 request id=...` then `2026-02-11T09:02:13Z ERROR toolcall: company-kb invocation failed: ValidationError: unexpected null for doc_id`
eng-runtime-lee: v7 changed the tool-resolver scoring to prefer lower-latency tools with new heuristics; the canary at 30% hit a subset of requests. It looks like a resolver alias mapped to `kb_lookup_v1` (legacy contract) for some code paths — expects `doc_id` instead of `query`.
support-alex: Repro steps I ran locally against production (guest account): 
1) send same payload using model=redwood-v7
2) observe assistant returns error block `ToolInvocationError` and tool proxy returns 401 when hitting legacy endpoint
Curl: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v7","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"lookup refund policy for order 123"}],"tools":["company-kb"]}'
```
support-alex: Attaching a small payload that demonstrates the schema mismatch: `{"query":"refund policy"}` vs expected `{"doc_id":"..."}` by the legacy resolver.
oncall-maya: tagging infra: @sre-bot can we confirm whether the legacy proxy started receiving more traffic post-rollout?
sre-bot: ALERT: legacy-kb-proxy rps increased 7x at 09:02 UTC, error rate to legacy auth endpoint jumped from 0.3% -> 12% (401). Possible auth token shape change observed for requests routed via `kb_lookup_v1` alias.
product-olivia: This looks like a regression introduced by the new resolver heuristics in v7. Can we patch resolver to prefer stable alias mapping until we update legacy contract?
eng-runtime-lee: Immediate mitigation options: 
- rollback model rollout to previous stable (redwood-v6.9) for affected tenant routing (fastest)
- hotfix to resolver scoring to hard-prefer `company-kb:stable` alias for queries that look like KB searches
- add a transformation shim in router to map `query` -> `doc_id` for legacy alias (hacky)
support-alex: Customer asking for ETA and rollback. They've hit billing noise and several failed requests in the feed.
oncall-maya: I'm initiating a partial rollback for the tenant routing group now (target 20% -> 5%). Will update when done.
eng-runtime-lee: Repro snippet of the error trace: 
```
Error: ToolInvocationError
  at resolver/select (resolver.go:421)
  reason: schema validation failed for company-kb
  details: { expected: [doc_id], got: [query] }
```
eng-runtime-lee: Root cause hypothesis: v7 resolver changed preferred tool variant and introduced an alias that maps to legacy contract without schema compatibility checks. The transformer we use for tool args isn't applied when alias=kb_lookup_v1.
product-olivia: Safety-first: rollback to v6.9 globally for 10 minutes while we test the resolver patch? That will reduce risk but could impact other users expecting v7 features.
oncall-maya: Rollback step executed for routing-group acme-media at 09:10 UTC -> confirmed 5% traffic. Monitoring RT and error delta.
support-alex: Customer confirms partial improvement but still seeing intermittent 400s — likely some requests still hitting v7 instances.
eng-runtime-lee: I pushed a resolver config change to force alias mapping for company-kb to stable variant (hotfix #4321). Rolling that to canary now, will take ~3 min to propagate.
eng-runtime-lee: After hotfix deploy: legacy-kb-proxy auth errors dropped to 1.1%, tool invocation validation errors down 90%. Latency normalized.
support-alex: Customer reports ~95% reduction in failed tool calls, still seeing occasional stale responses but okay for now. They asked for postmortem and timeline.
product-olivia: Action items: 
- eng-runtime: ship a permanent resolver compatibility check (block mismatched schema mappings) — P0
- eng-runtime: add automated contract test for tool aliases in rollout pipelines — P1
- support: provide customer with timeline + temporary bill adjustment request
- infra/sre: monitor legacy proxy for 24h and alert on auth 4xx spikes
eng-runtime-lee: I'll open the PR for the resolver check and add the contract test. ETA 48h.
oncall-maya: Closing immediate incident; continuing watch. :white_check_mark:
support-alex: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the customer postmortem and credit request.
product-olivia: Let's also add a canary check that validates tool invocation shape end-to-end before increasing rollout percent. Good catch. :+1:
